item.title: Rats caught on camera hunting flying bats
item.description:

item.title: Bichon: A lightweight, high-performance Rust email archiver with WebUI
item.description:
📝 Bichon A lightweight, high-performance Rust email archiver with WebUI Bichon is an open-source email archiving system that synchronizes emails from IMAP servers, indexes them for full-text search, and provides a REST API for programmatic access. Unlike email clients, Bichon is designed for archiving and searching rather than sending/receiving emails. Bichon is completely free.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/rustmailer/bichon
